opening.argument: The presentation promotes an MTI account by stating that “your Bitcoin is growing daily” and that trading profits are added each day for compound interest. It identifies Bitcoin as the trading currency, invites viewers to add more Bitcoin, and provides a registration link with instructions to register. It also presents withdrawal terms, stating that withdrawals take up to 48 hours, can be for any amount, and carry no fees. Taken together, these are direct participation and growth claims supporting an investment pool, lending or staking-return proposition. The material does include the limitation that “historical results are not an indication of future results,” and it does not verify the claimed profits, account operation, or withdrawal outcomes.
